post.description:
Collect every SKU of a service (`Compute Engine`, `Cloud Storage`, `BigQuery`) for a price panel. For free text use search; for one id use records_get.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page for the same service and currency (tag.offset.publisher-token).

page_size.description:
Records per answer. The publisher page (hint 200) holds a few thousand SKUs; the cursor carries an offset into it so answers stay bounded.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 2000; default 500.

service_id.description: Optional service id (e.g. `6F81-5844-456A` for Compute Engine); when given it is the filter instead of the name. Pattern: ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}$.

service_name.description: Service display name as the publisher shows it, e.g. `Compute Engine`; matched case-insensitively against each answer group's service name.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Walk the SKUs of one Google Cloud service through the SKU browser RPC: the service display name is the query and the answer is filtered to SKUs whose service matches (`service_id` when given, else the display name). One record per SKU with every tier's price string in the requested currency; cursor-paginated with `page_size` records per answer. The cursor is bound to the service and currency it was issued for. Coverage is reported partial: the publisher's search index, not the keyed Catalog API, defines completeness, and the keyless surface has no publication version to pin, so a price change between pages cannot be detected.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `next_cursor` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `other_services_dropped` | number | SKUs of other services the search also matched on this page and that were filtered out. |
| `record_count` | number |  |
| `records` | object[] |  |
| `service_id` | string |  |
| `service_name` | string | The matched service's display name as published. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Find SKUs by words in their description (`E2 Instance Core`, `Network Internet Egress`) or by service name. For one known SKU id use records_get; to walk one service use records_list.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code the publisher should price in (USD and EUR observed). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{3}$.

Provider reference: default "USD".

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page for the same query and currency.

page_size_hint.description:
Passed to the publisher as its page-size argument; results per page vary around it.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 30.

query.description: Free text; the publisher rejects an empty query.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

value.query: E2 Instance Core running in Americas

200.description:
Free-text search over Google Cloud SKU descriptions and service names (the SKU browser RPC). Returns one record per SKU with service, regions and one price string per tier in the requested currency, plus a continuation cursor. The page-size hint is not a strict page size: the publisher groups results by service and returns variable counts (10 to a few thousand SKUs per page).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `next_cursor` | string | Opaque; pass back as `cursor` with the same query and currency. Null when exhausted. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `record_count` | number |  |
| `records` | object[] |  |
| `services` | object[] | Services present on this page, in the publisher's order. |

post.description:
Before a collection run, to see whether the SKU group catalog changed; to list the group slugs use sku_groups.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Cheap version check of the keyless surface: fetches the SKU groups index (cloud.google.com/skus/sku-groups), reports its `last-modified` header as `published_at`, the group count and a SHA-256 over the sorted group slugs as `content_hash`. The SKU browser RPC itself publishes no version; price records carry the collection day as `publication_id`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content_hash` | string | sha256 hex over the newline-joined, sorted group slugs. |
| `group_count` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `price_versioning` | string | Fixed statement of what this surface can and cannot version. |
| `publication_id` | string | `sku-groups:<first 16 hex of content_hash>`. |
| `published_at` | string | The index page's `last-modified` header as RFC 3339 UTC; null when the header is absent. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `size_bytes` | number | Decoded size of the index page. |
| `source_url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.price_versioning: none: the SKU browser exposes no effective date; records carry the UTC collection day as publication_id
